acquisition method: The mass spectrometer was operated in a data-dependent acquisition mode
cleavage agent: Samples were digested with 2 μg trypsin in 50 mM NH4HCO3 at 37 °C overnight.
enrichment method: Streptavidin affinity capture of biotinylated proteins coupled to mass spectrometry identified all augmin subunits
fractionation method: diluted to 20% acetonitrile/0.25% formic acid before loading into strong cation exchange columns (polyLC SCX).
fragmentation method: the top speed (most intense) ions were fragmented by CID and detected in the linear ion trap.
instrument: The outlet of the column was directly connected to a TriVersa NanoMate (Advion) fitted on an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos™ Tribrid (Thermo Scientific).
labeling: unique peptide spectrum matches of protein groups identified with Sequest HT and Andromeda were analyzed with SAINTexpress-spc v3.11
mass analyzer: the top speed (most intense) ions were fragmented by CID and detected in the linear ion trap.
precursor tolerance: Peptide mass tolerance was 10 ppm and the MS/MS tolerance was 0.6 Da.
fragment tolerance: Peptide mass tolerance was 10 ppm and the MS/MS tolerance was 0.6 Da.
ptm: oxidation in M; acetylation in protein N-terminus
Search parameters for trypsin enzyme specificity allowed for two missed cleavage sites, oxidation in M and acetylation in protein N-terminus.
